name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), domain 'chapter', descriptor ch23_end_scene_char_pos_x_table. 'ch23' is the chapter ID (23 within valid 01-30 range, meaningful domain ID, must keep). 'table' reflects the array datatype. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x522a3). Consistent with sibling data_fd2_chapter_ch21_end_scene_char_pos_x_table and the two sibling ch23 tables (pos_y, facing).
purpose: Chapter-23 end-scene character X-position table: per-char-slot tile X coordinates used to stage the cast during the chapter 23 end handler intro.
logic_summary: First of three sibling private read-only tables at 0x522A3 (pos_x), 0x522B4 (pos_y, +17), 0x522C5 (facing, +34). Referenced only by fd2_chapter_23_end, which copies each 17-byte table onto stack scratch (Watcom prologue: four dwords + trailing byte = 17-byte extent) and passes the pointers as arg1/arg2/arg3 into fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(pos_x, pos_y, facing, 0, 0x10, 0x11, 0x15, 0x15, 2, 0xE, 0xE), which indexes the tables by character slot to place chars and re-aim the camera.
element_semantics: Per-char-slot tile X coordinate (column) for end-scene character placement. Values 0x14,0x14,0x12,0x13,0x14,0x15,0x16,0x12,0x16,0x12,0x13,0x15,0x16,0x13,0x14,0x15,0x13 (decimal 20,20,18,19,20,21,22,18,22,18,19,21,22,19,20,21,19). Index is the character slot consumed by fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro.
comment_original_issue: Original comment said 'Five chars are placed (slots 0, 0x10, 0x11)' which is internally inconsistent (states 'Five' but lists only 3 slots) and is an unverified claim about how fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro consumes its slot/camera arguments. Replaced with the verified sibling-21 pattern: explicit arg1/arg2/arg3 mapping of the three table pointers, keeping the verified facing-table observation.
notes: Reader xrefs to 0x522A3: READ + DATA, both from fd2_chapter_23_end; zero game-side write -> const confirmed (src already declares const uint8). Sibling tables (pos_y @0x522B4, facing @0x522C5) are referenced by the same reader and copied in the same loop; their refine is out of scope for this symbol. Ghidra data plate at 0x522A3 was empty (null); created a concise src-derived plate. src comment block (chend2.c lines ~337-345) covers all three sibling tables and was rewritten to the verified pattern.
